name: com.unity.sdk.linux-x86_64
description: This package contains the sysroot used to build and run Unity players on 64-bit Linux systems. It includes the system libraries and headers required by Unity’s runtime environment to ensure compatibility with common Linux distributions during both compilation and execution.
